title: Nuclear Decay Equations
text_content:
## Types of Radioactive Radiation

**Alpha decay:** ${}^A_Z X \rightarrow {}^{A-4}_{Z-2}Y + {}^4_2\text{He}$

**Beta-minus decay:** ${}^A_Z X \rightarrow {}^A_{Z+1}Y + {}^0_{-1}e + \bar{\nu}_e$ (antineutrino emitted)

**Law of Radioactive Decay**
Radioactive decay is **random** and **spontaneous**.

$$N(t) = N_0 e^{-\lambda t}$$

**Half-life** $t_{1/2}$: time for half of the nuclei to decay:
$$t_{1/2} = \frac{\ln 2}{\lambda} = \frac{0.693}{\lambda}$$

$$N = N_0 \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^n \quad \text{where } n = \frac{t}{t_{1/2}}$$
